items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I did a film on Joe Williams, a documentary on Joe Williams that Monk was very involved in... we did this documentary on Joe Williams

ctx.x: Was there a model for you? Things to look at?

No. I mean the more I started doing it the more I looked at other people’s work. But I’ll just finish, so I happened to know someone at what was then called ABC Video Enterprises, which was the forerunner of Arts & Entertainment Network. And I went to them — I think I contacted David Chertok, the film collector. I saw an article about him in the New York Times. And I went to him and I said, “David, let’s do a history of jazz series together.” It was very bold, I’d never made a film. Oh I take it back, I take it…
He was on board for that.
